 WTA Tokyo Semifinal Best Bets Including Diana Shnaider vs Mia Pohankova 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 The WTA Tokyo tournament, also known as the Pan Pacific Open, begins in Japan. This is a WTA 500 event, but it has no bearing on the upcoming WTA Finals and the race to Indian Wells. That competition is over, with the WTA formally announcing in early November that all eight singles players have qualified. The Pan Pacific Open is therefore a straightforward tournament where players try to build their rankings for the start of the 2027 season and earn prize money. A 500-point tournament offers the chance to make a major gain in the rankings. It’s a lot more than a WTA 250. Let’s see which players still have the energy and form to make a run at this late-season tournament and build confidence heading into the offseason. Fall tennis differs from spring or summer tennis because some players are more tired at this point in the year, opening the door for others to make their mark at this 2026 WTA Tokyo event. LWOS has our best bets for three matches. Post your best bets and thoughts in the comments. 
 WTA Tokyo 
 Fernandez – Rakhimova: 22:00 EST 
 H2H: 1-1 
 In this WTA Tokyo match, the two semifinalists enter the court in different positions. Leylah Fernandez got a retirement from Elena Rybakina in the quarterfinals, so she did not play a lot of tennis. Kamilla Rakhimova, on the other hand, played three full sets in her win over Maya Joint. One player is fresher. One player has more rhythm and match play. Which will matter more? 
 Best Bet to Make 
 This WTA Tokyo match betting play is for Fernandez, whose physical freshness should matter in the semifinal round of a tournament near the end of a very long tennis season. Getting a shorter quarterfinal will give Fernandez more energy against Rakhimova, who could be fatigued in this spot. 
 That being said, betting on Fernandez -3.5 games is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Fernandez -3.5 games at @1.69 @betfair

 Shnaider – Pohankova: 23:30 EST 
 H2H: 0-0 
 This WTA Tokyo match is a battle of in-form players. Diana Shnaider just defeated Alexandra Eala, a really good win. Mia Pohankova defeated Naomi Osaka earlier this week. Both players have been terrific this week. Now they meet for a spot in the final.  
 Best Bet to Make 
 This WTA Tokyo match is not a matchup most people predicted before the tournament began. Both players have played well this week, but Shnaider has 14 more hardcourt wins this year than Pohankova (26-12) and is the generally better player overall. Take Shnaider to win in straight sets. 
 That being said, betting on Shnaider winning 2:0 is a value bet for sure. 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Shnaider winning 2:0 @1.95 @betway
